label: nitaeru
title: 〜にたえる
meaning: has value; it is worth doing 十分に〜に値する・どうにか〜することができる。
meaning_example: It is worth reading that book

notes.text: 耐える = to put up with, be able bear.
notes.html: 耐える = to put up with, be able bear.

notes.text: Ref # Kanzen Master Level 1 - p67 - no.64

注意

While the verb 耐える as a piece of vocabulary means being able to withstand / endure, the grammar phrase にたえる means to deserve, be worthy of, to have value in... にたえる is completely different from 耐える!
notes.html:
注意
While the verb 耐える as a piece of vocabulary means being able to withstand / endure, the grammar phrase にたえる means to deserve, be worthy of, to have value in... にたえる is completely different from 耐える!

notes.text: Customarily used with a set number of words such as  市販、鑑賞、読む、見る、聞く、批判、評価 (worthy of being sold, admired, read, seen, heard, criticism/comment, evaluation)
notes.html: Customarily used with a set number of words such as  市販、鑑賞、読む、見る、聞く、批判、評価 (worthy of being sold, admired, read, seen, heard, criticism/comment, evaluation)

examples.japanese: 十分読むにたえる作品だ。
examples.body_text:
十分読むにたえる作品だ。 

		That book 
		is worth 
		reading
examples.body_html:
十分読むにたえる作品だ。 
That book is worth reading

examples.japanese: 趣味で始めた焼き物だが、ようやく市販するにたえる作品ができるようになった
examples.body_text:
趣味で始めた焼き物だが、ようやく市販するにたえる作品ができるようになった 

		I just started cooking things as a hobby, but pretty soon I was making stuff that was 
		good enough for 
		sale
examples.body_html:
趣味で始めた焼き物だが、ようやく市販するにたえる作品ができるようになった 
I just started cooking things as a hobby, but pretty soon I was making stuff that was good enough for sale

examples.japanese: あの子は大人の鑑賞にたえる絵を描く
examples.body_text:
あの子は大人の鑑賞にたえる絵を描く 

		That kid draws pictures that are 
		worthy of 
		adult appreciation.
examples.body_html:
あの子は大人の鑑賞にたえる絵を描く 
That kid draws pictures that are worthy of adult appreciation.

examples.japanese: ずいぶん値段が安いけど、使用にたえるかどうか、ちゃんと確認して買った方がいい。
examples.body_text:
ずいぶん値段が安いけど、使用にたえるかどうか、ちゃんと確認して買った方がいい。 

		The price may be very cheap, but before you buy it you should make sure to check whether it merits use or not.
examples.body_html:
ずいぶん値段が安いけど、使用にたえるかどうか、ちゃんと確認して買った方がいい。  
The price may be very cheap, but before you buy it you should make sure to check whether it merits use or not.
